title: Cursor hooks.json
description: Cursor Hooks configuration. Sources: enterprise > team > project (.cursor/hooks.json) > user (~/.cursor/hooks.json). Docs: https://cursor.com/docs/hooks

version.description: Config schema version. Positive integer; use 1.

hooks.description: Maps hook event names to ordered arrays of hook definitions.

sessionStart.description: Composer conversation created. Fire-and-forget; may return `env` and `additional_context`.

preToolUse.description: Before any tool runs. Matcher: tool type (Shell, Read, Write, Grep, Delete, Task, MCP:<tool_name>).

postToolUse.description: After a successful tool run. Matcher: tool type.

postToolUseFailure.description: Tool failed / timed out / denied. Matcher: tool type.

subagentStart.description: Before a subagent (Task) spawns. Matcher: subagent type (generalPurpose, explore, shell, ...).

subagentStop.description: Subagent completed / errored / aborted. Matcher: subagent type. Supports `loop_limit`.

beforeShellExecution.description: Before a shell command. Matcher: full command string.

afterShellExecution.description: After a shell command. Matcher: full command string.

beforeMCPExecution.description: Before an MCP tool call. `failClosed: true` recommended.

beforeReadFile.description: Before Agent reads a file. Matcher value: `Read`.

afterFileEdit.description: After Agent edits a file. Matcher value: `Write`.

beforeSubmitPrompt.description: After send, before backend request. Matcher value: `UserPromptSubmit`.

stop.description: Agent loop ended; may return `followup_message`. Matcher value: `Stop`. Supports `loop_limit`.

beforeTabFileRead.description: Before Tab reads a file. Matcher value: `TabRead`.

afterTabFileEdit.description: After Tab edits a file. Matcher value: `TabWrite`.

workspaceOpen.description: Workspace opened / folders changed. May return `pluginPaths`. Not run in cloud agents.

command.description: Shell string, absolute path, or relative path. Project hooks: relative to project root. User hooks: relative to ~/.cursor/.

timeout.description: Execution timeout in seconds. Platform default if omitted.

failClosed.description: When true, crash/timeout/non-zero exit/no output blocks the action. Permission hooks block on invalid JSON regardless.

matcher.description: Regex filter. Empty string or "*" matches everything. Tested against a value that depends on the hook event.

type.description: LLM-evaluated hook. Returns { ok: boolean, reason?: string }. Not supported in cloud agents.

prompt.description: Natural-language condition. $ARGUMENTS is replaced by hook input JSON (auto-appended if absent).
